items.title: Joe Williams interviewed by Leslie Gourse, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: I remember one woman saying to me once... Rosemary Clifford Wilson.

ctx.x: Not carried away by publicity perhaps. Able to keep that level head.

Yeah. I’ve known people that just were amusing. And they know how to push your buttons. And they keep you laughing uproariously all the time. And that’s a gift in itself, to be able to make people laugh. I remember one woman saying to me once she says, “They must be kidding, talking about making marijuana legal.” She said, “If they did nothing would get done.” Wonderful. And she also said something very spiritual I think. When Mr. Basie died she says, “What are we going to do? Because Basie used to come to town…
